data.body: **[P2] Bound generation bookkeeping with the cache.** The 256-entry limit applies only to completed values; every unique serialization or deserialization context is inserted here and never removed. Replaying a long workflow or a large map can therefore retain one key per historical operation for the entire invocation and exhaust Lambda memory. Evict generation state together with completed/in-flight entries, or use bounded context invalidation, and test that all runner bookkeeping remains bounded across many unique entities.
